title: DHARA Newsletter - June 18, 2026
description: 96 School is out! Congrats to all our DH graduates! There are a lot of great events coming up at the pool and we hope to see you there. Check out the details below. Summer hours are going into effect, which means more time at the pool. See below for details as we transition into summer. Swim lessons registration is open! More info and registration link available here . Some quick programming notes to highlight: Ping Pong open play that was scheduled for tonight is cancelled. The next open play will be Monday, July 13. Joint us for the World Cup Watch Party TOMORROW in the Community Room! GO USA! The pool is open until 7PM tonight for general swim, will close for swim practice, and will reopen from 9-10PM for evening lap swim. 📅 UPCOMING EVENTS ⚽FIFA WORLD CUP WATCH PARTY at DH ⚽ Team USA vs. Australia 📅 June 19 🕝 2:30 PM 📍 Community Room Come cheer on Team USA as they take on Australia in World Cup action! We'll be watching the match on our new large-screen TV with fellow pool members and plenty of World Cup excitement. Bring your favorite food and beverages (BYOB) and get ready to cheer, celebrate, and enjoy a fun afternoon at the pool. 🔴 PING PONG OPEN PLAY – Thursday, June 18 CANCELLED Keep posted for a rescheduled event! Otherwise, the next Open Play will be Monday, July 13. 🌴SAVE THE DATE!🌴 The DH Luau returns Saturday, July 11 ! Join us for an evening of island fun, great company, and tropical vibes. Sorry, kids--this one's for the grown-ups. 🀄 MAHJONG SUMMER OPEN PLAY
